about: stars-gui's application mutants (wf10 corpus wave GP1a): edits of the example, each with the law or the test that kills it. A killer examples/stars-gui/PKG:law L is `ergo test examples/stars-gui/PKG --law L`; cmd/ergo:TestStarsGuiAgreesWithControl is the seeded agreement property against the reference model and the hand Go control, which kills the mutants no law sees.

mutants.name: stars-window-lets-cursor-fall-below
mutants.rule: The window always holds the cursor's row.

mutants.name: stars-sort-clears-selection
mutants.from: Stay[State]{Next: Browsing{G: Settle(Grid{..g, View: view, Key: key, Cursor: follow(view, at, g.Cursor)})}}
mutants.to: Stay[State]{Next: Browsing{G: Settle(Grid{..g, View: view, Key: key, Cursor: follow(view, at, g.Cursor), Selected: []int{}})}}
mutants.rule: A sort keeps the selected stars.

mutants.name: stars-narrow-keeps-every-row
mutants.rule: A typed letter keeps only the shown stars that the longer filter keeps.

mutants.name: stars-order-always-keeps-the-first
mutants.rule: A filter keeps a star only when the filter is in its name or constellation.

mutants.name: stars-sort-adds-a-row
mutants.rule: A sort shows exactly the ids it is given.

mutants.name: stars-fixed-drops-leading-zeros
mutants.rule: A fixed-point number prints every decimal place: 1.05, not 1.5.

mutants.name: stars-distance-sets-declination
mutants.rule: An edit of a column changes that column.

mutants.name: stars-catalogue-joins-with-spaces
mutants.rule: A catalogue line separates its cells with tabs, so it reads back.

mutants.name: stars-edit-is-never-opened
mutants.from: Enter[State]{Next: Editing{G: g, Row: id.Value, Column: e.Column, Draft: CellText(CellOf(g.Rows[id.Value], e.Column))}}
mutants.to: Enter[State]{Next: Filtering{G: g, Before: CellText(CellOf(g.Rows[id.Value], e.Column))}}
mutants.rule: Edit opens the draft of the cell under the cursor.

mutants.name: stars-filter-is-never-started
mutants.rule: Filter starts a filter from browsing.

mutants.name: stars-up-writes-down
mutants.rule: A command's line reads back as the command.

mutants.name: stars-cursor-mark-on-top-row
mutants.rule: A frame marks the row under the cursor.

mutants.name: stars-edit-leaves-the-cursor
mutants.rule: After an edit moves a row, the cursor stays on that row.

mutants.name: stars-cancel-clears-the-filter
mutants.from: Filter: f.Before, View: Order(g.Rows, f.Before, g.Key)
mutants.rule: Cancel of a filter restores the filter it started from.

mutants.name: stars-selection-stops-short
mutants.rule: A selection runs from the anchor to the cursor, both included.
